feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: The Army says there's no reason to panic over controlled ammunition detonation in Iowa
entry.summary: The U.S. Army says it has taken precautions and there's no reason to panic about its' plan to detonate unusable bomb making material at its ammunition plant in Iowa, scheduled for Wednesday morning.

entry.title: How tariffs, fuel and fertilizer costs are squeezing the U.S.'s biggest apple region
entry.summary: Washington's $9 billion industry grows more than 70% of the nation's fresh apples. Farmers are being pressed by high costs, tariffs and a strong dollar that diminishes foreign purchasing power.

entry.title: Court lifts administrative stay, allowing lead azide detonation to move forward
entry.summary: It's been an on-off-and-on again schedule for the Army's plan to detonate tons of unusable bomb-making material in Iowa with even President Trump weighing in on what should happen.

entry.title: Black travelers on Route 66 weren't welcome at most gas stations — except this one
entry.summary: Threatt Filling Station in Luther, Okla., was the first Black-owned gas station on Route 66. At a time when Black families needed the Green Book to find places to stay, eat, use the bathroom, it provided fuel and respite.

entry.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
entry.summary: High in the Colombian Andes, a growing number of volunteers are racing to save an unusual plant that helps supply water to millions — one tiny seedling at a time.

entry.title: This group of seamstresses mends shirts to make chemo easier for cancer patients
entry.summary: Seamstresses in Ohio and other states are making zippered shirts for cancer patients so they can more comfortably undergo chemotherapy treatments.

entry.title: Residents of Berkeley, California, vote to double their soda tax
entry.summary: Since 2014, Berkeley, California has had an extra tax on soda and sugary drinks. During the midterms, residents voted to double that tax.

entry.title: Chicago now has the worst traffic in the U.S. — here's why
entry.summary: Chicago takes the top ranking for traffic jams according to a pair of new analyses, and according to its many, many frustrated drivers who waste hours of their lives stuck in them.

entry.title: Let's talk turkey: Here's how Thanksgiving meal costs have changed this year
entry.summary: Grocery costs have been on the rise, but food-price analysts say it's unclear if you'll spend more on the Thanksgiving meal this year. Some people are deciding not to host or are hosting fewer guests.

entry.title: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
entry.summary: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.
